scope: Read-only review of the seven requested implementation/test files. CSS .building display:block was excluded because it is separately owned.

verified_invariants.invariant: Work cannot create real income and the model remains synthetic.
evidence: simulation-core/model.mjs:1-6 labels the sandbox synthetic, initializes settled_cash to NOT_CONNECTED, and has no account/provider capability.
simulation-core/model.mjs:15-25 makes work consume energy only; :27-28 advances a day with a synthetic cash decrement only.
tests/model.test.mjs:4-13 asserts work preserves cash_cents and NOT_CONNECTED; :15-20 asserts no-sales cost behavior; :27-31 rejects LIVE mode.
Local execution: node --test tests/model.test.mjs tests/events.test.mjs passed 6/6 on 2026-10-17.

verified_invariants.invariant: Event journal accepts a bounded typed action shape and exports a synthetic, non-connected DTO only.
evidence: mcp-bridge/events.mjs:2-3 allowlists action types and nodes.
mcp-bridge/events.mjs:9-15 rejects unknown action types, unexpected fields, invalid select nodes, and nodes on non-select actions before constructing the fixed event DTO.
mcp-bridge/events.mjs:21-22 exports connection NOT_CONNECTED and cloned retained event records.
tests/events.test.mjs:13-19 covers free-form-field, external-action, and foreign-node rejection.

verified_invariants.invariant: HTTP does not serve audit/seed/.git or traversal paths in the reviewed server surface.
evidence: scripts/serve.py:8-18 maps only five exact canonical paths after urlsplit/unquote; all other paths resolve to None.
scripts/serve.py:26-41 sends 404 before SimpleHTTPRequestHandler for non-allowlisted GET/HEAD paths.
tests/test_server.py:13-18 covers .git, seed, audit, ordinary traversal, encoded traversal, and double-encoded traversal; local unittest passed 2/2.

verified_invariants.invariant: The reviewed UI imports only local simulator seams and labels its money, work, rest, and export as synthetic/non-payment behavior.
evidence: engine-isometric-ui/app.mjs:5-9 and :13 label prototype claims, unknown income, no payments, synthetic energy, and simulated work.
engine-isometric-ui/app.mjs:33-38 creates a local JSON Blob download only; no network/API call appears in this file.
No browser/DOM execution was run in this review.

covered_by_execution: event DTO retention and free-form/external/foreign-node rejection
semantic_coverage.reason: The executed tests directly cover the named safety contracts but do not establish UI rendering or product acceptance.

review_limits: No implementation file was edited and no server was started.
No provider, network, external effect, install, or source-project mutation occurred.
NO_CHANGE means no material defect was found in this bounded review; it is not full product or runtime acceptance.
